# ASD World
> Helping Parents Help Kids: Musings, IEP guidance, special education legal strategy, and autism family resources by Rick Colosimo.

ASD World provides comprehensive perspectives, guidance, and actionable insights on autism spectrum disorder (ASD), IEP meetings, special education strategy, employment models for adults on the spectrum, and insurance considerations.

## Core Pages
- [Home]({{ '/' | absolute_url }}): Recent articles, blog posts, and educational guides.
- [ASD Insurance]({{ '/asd-insurance/' | absolute_url }}): Autism health insurance considerations and parent sharing.
- [Consultations]({{ '/consultations/' | absolute_url }}): Advisory consultations and direct help for families.
- [Services & IEP Guidance]({{ '/services-2/' | absolute_url }}): IEP preparation, strategy, and advocacy.
- [I need IEP help!]({{ '/services-2/i-need-iep-help/' | absolute_url }}): Targeted assistance for parents navigating the IEP process.
- [Disclosures]({{ '/services-2/disclosures/' | absolute_url }}): Important legal and consultation disclosures.
- [About Rick Colosimo]({{ '/about-rick-colosimo/' | absolute_url }}): Background of Rick Colosimo, attorney, veteran, and parent advocate.
- [My Approach]({{ '/about-rick-colosimo/my-approach/' | absolute_url }}): Philosophy and practical approach to advocacy.
- [FAQ & Fees]({{ '/faq/' | absolute_url }}): Frequently asked questions and advisory fee structure.
- [Contact]({{ '/contact-rick/' | absolute_url }}): Direct contact information and communication channels.
